episodes.synopsis: After eating mushrooms that make him sick, Red is captured by a mysterious masked creature with serious survival skills.
episodes.title: Mango

episodes.synopsis: Yellow helps his pal plan a romantic night for two when Red gets a crush on a brave and pretty larva.
episodes.title: Mango 2

episodes.synopsis: Larva friends Red and Yellow wake up to find themselves on a tropical island with exotic animals -- and one gigantic creature.
episodes.title: Larva Island

episodes.synopsis: Red and Yellow watch curiously as their human neighbor scribbles marks on a wall, tries to build a boat and eats a meal made entirely of greens.
episodes.title: Chuck

episodes.synopsis: Chuck meets a lovable seal who shares his girlfriend's name -- and becomes everyone's favorite creature on the island.
episodes.title: Clara

episodes.synopsis: After an extraterrestrial object lands on the island, a crab eats it and acquires unexpected powers.
episodes.title: Crabsformer

episodes.synopsis: When hungry Chuck goes fishing, using Red and Yellow as bait, he catches a huge fish with a swordlike beak and some crazy fight moves.
episodes.title: Fishing

episodes.synopsis: After a mudskipper steals Chuck's locket, Red and Yellow venture into the underground fish world to get it back.
episodes.title: Pendant

episodes.synopsis: Lonely Yellow gets stuck in a glass bottle that ships him to New York City, where he reunites with old friends -- and an old flame.
episodes.title: Lala Island

episodes.synopsis: Everyone on the island loves Yellow's yummy dishes, inspiring a jealous Red to train himself in the art of cooking.
episodes.title: Master Chef

episodes.synopsis: Red and Yellow discover corn kernels in a booby bird's droppings and decide to plant them, only to learn they've created a monster.
episodes.title: Farming

episodes.synopsis: A spooky hat Clara fetches from the ocean turns Chuck into an evil pirate, complete with a ship and a skeleton crew.
episodes.title: Pirate

episodes.synopsis: Chuck learns what it's like to be a larva on the island when lightning strikes -- and he switches bodies with Yellow!
episodes.title: Change
